narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience on a specific concept in criminal psychology: 'Psychological Reward.' It uses the example of voyeurism to explain how the thrill of potentially being caught can be more rewarding for the perpetrator than the act itself, ultimately serving as a promotional teaser for an expert-led course.
